data.title: Solana Is Faster and Cheaper Than Ethereum. So Why Is ETH Worth 5 Times More?
data.description: Solana confirms transactions in 150 milliseconds and charges a fraction of what Ethereum does, yet investors keep pouring money into ETH at a nearly fivefold premium. The reasons behind that gap reveal something surprising about what Wall Street actually values in a blockchain.
